## Objective
- Complete NEON TIDELINE as a playable browser game using the existing lobby and standalone `game.js`.

## Requirements
- Retain the lobby and build offline battle royale gameplay.
- Keep gameplay in `game.js`, loaded by `index.html`.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Kept the existing lobby and implemented the gameplay as a standalone script.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added gameplay systems in `game.js`: movement, bots, shooting, storm, loot, HUD/minimap, rendering, pause, match results, and lobby return.
- Updated `index.html` with game HUD, results, toast, touch controls, and full-viewport game positioning.
- Fixed the empty results overlay so it does not obscure gameplay.
- Verified syntax, gameplay launch, pause/resume, and lobby return in Chromium at 1280×720; no page errors.
- Captured and inspected the latest screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/neon-tideline.jpg`.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Summarize the completed work and verification, noting reasonable gameplay assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: lobby, game container, and gameplay UI styles.
- `game.js`: standalone offline gameplay implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted: `index.html` is modified and `game.js` is untracked.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` pass.
